verified_hold.scope: Exact native camera/vessel states for all holds and nine seams; does not imply pixel-identical H.264 frames.

ffmpeg.version: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: Native holds/seams are exact motion states, not a promise of pixel-identical video.
H.264 and JPEG are lossy; raw and decoded differences are recorded without invented acceptance thresholds.
Contacts and technical checks do not certify full-speed comfort or artistic acceptance.
